asA: developer whose Worker needs to schedule two or more distinct workloads on distinct cron cadences
iWant: one dispatcher module (src/dispatcher.mjs) that accepts an ordered map of cron expressions to handler functions and, on every scheduled invocation, routes to the matched handler with a bounded context
soThat: one wrangler.toml [triggers] block with multiple cron expressions cleanly maps to distinct handler code paths without hand-rolled conditionals

acceptanceCriteria.description: createDispatcher({routes: [{expression, handler}, ...], eventSink}) returns a dispatch(event) function. Calling dispatch({cron: '* * * * *', scheduledTime}) invokes exactly the handler whose expression is '* * * * *' and passes {expression, scheduledTime, sink} to it; no other route's handler is called on that dispatch.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher wired with two routes and two spy handlers
acceptanceCriteria.when: dispatch is called with a specific expression
acceptanceCriteria.then: only the matched spy handler is invoked exactly once with the bounded context

acceptanceCriteria.description: Calling dispatch({cron: expressionNotInRoutes, scheduledTime}) does NOT invoke any handler, fires a cronUnmatched event on the sink with metadata {expression, scheduledTime, outcome: unmatched, duration: 0} and returns without side effect.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher wired with two routes and two spy handlers
acceptanceCriteria.when: dispatch is called with an expression not in the routes
acceptanceCriteria.then: no spy is called, a cronUnmatched event fires, and dispatch returns without side effect

title: T-2 dispatcher routes multiple cron expressions to distinct handlers by expression match
